input.rationale: Listeria monocytogenes in chilled ready-to-eat soups and sauces carries a reasonable probability of serious illness or death, and the product is already on store shelves, so the public must be told.

call.name: propose_classification

input.rationale: Listeria monocytogenes in chilled ready-to-eat soups and sauces carries a reasonable probability of serious illness or death, and the product is already on store shelves, so the public must be told.

call.summary: Proposed Class I, consumer-level recall. Awaiting confirmation
cypher:
MERGE (i:Incident {lot: $lot})
ON CREATE SET i.id = $id, i.reported_at = $at, i.hazard = 'not recorded'
SET i.class = $class, i.depth = $depth, i.rationale = $rationale, i.classified_at = $at
RETURN i.id AS id, i.hazard AS hazard

events.text: Next I'm placing a hold so nothing more ships.

call.name: place_hold
call.summary: 2,652 units and 93 kg of raw L-204 held at 5 locations
cypher:
MATCH (l:Lot {code: $lot})-[s:STORED_AT]->(site:Site)
RETURN site.id AS id, site.name AS name, site.city AS city, site.region AS region, s.qty_kg AS qty_kg, l.received_kg AS received_kg

MATCH (:Lot {code: $lot})-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED*1..6]->(pl:ProductLot)-[h:HELD_AT]->(loc)
WITH DISTINCT pl, h, loc
MATCH (pl)-[:OF]->(p:Product)
RETURN pl.id AS product_lot, p.name AS product, labels(loc)[0] AS kind, loc.id AS id, loc.name AS name,
       loc.city AS city, loc.region AS region, h.units AS units
ORDER BY kind, id, product_lot

MATCH (:Lot {code: $lot})-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED*1..6]->(:ProductLot)-[h:HELD_AT]->()
SET h.held_for = $lot, h.held_at = $at

events.text: Now I'm tracing the lot forward to every store and checking for deliveries with no lot code.

call.name: trace_forward
cypher:
MATCH path = (l:Lot {code: $lot})-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED|SHIPPED_TO*1..8]->(st:Store)
RETURN st.id AS store,
       [n IN nodes(path) | coalesce(n.code, n.id)] AS path,
       [n IN nodes(path) | labels(n)[0]] AS kinds,
       last(relationships(path)).units AS units

call.name: coverage_gaps
call.summary: 2 stores got Garden Vegetable Stew with no lot code on the delivery record
cypher:
MATCH (:Lot {code: $lot})-[:USED_IN|REWORKED_INTO|PRODUCED*1..6]->(pl:ProductLot)
WITH collect(DISTINCT pl.sku) AS skus
MATCH (p:Product)-[u:SHIPPED_UNTRACKED]->(st:Store)
WHERE p.sku IN skus
RETURN st.id AS store, p.sku AS sku, p.name AS product, u.units AS units, u.shipped_at AS shipped_at

MATCH (l:Lot)-[:USED_IN]->(:Batch)-[:REWORKED_INTO*0..3]->(:Batch)-[:PRODUCED]->(pl:ProductLot)

result.summary: I've proposed Class I with consumer depth for Listeria monocytogenes in diced carrot lot L-204, because it can cause serious illness or death in chilled ready-to-eat soups and sauces that are already on shelves. A hold now covers the 93 kg of unused carrot at Northfield Plant 2 and 2,652 unshipped units at three distribution centres and two plants. The lot went into batches B-03, B-05, B-07 and B-09 and seven product lots, reaching 31 stores (2,207 units); B-09 reused leftovers from B-03, so it spread the carrot further as Carrot & Lentil Soup lot TLC-09A. Following policy, I added stores ST-013 and ST-021 (25 and 24 units of Garden Vegetable Stew) because their deliveries have no lot code, so we can't prove they're safe. A separate backward trace of the eight lots the cleared stores received found none containing L-204. A blanket recall would cover 71 stores, the targeted recall covers 33 and pulls 2,256 units, 38 stores are cleared, and the class, the hold release and the 33 draft notices (not sent) all need the recall coordinator's approval.
